visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Real-world clinic interior. A female doctor with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a professional beige blazer over a white shirt, leans over an elderly female patient. The patient is lying flat on a medical bed with metallic eye shields. The doctor points to the patient's facial skin while speaking. The background features clinical equipment and a colorful modern painting. (2) Close-up shot of the patient's face during a procedure. A doctor's hand uses a medical laser device that emits brief flashes of light onto the skin near the eye. A magnifying lens is held nearby for precision. The background is blurred, showing medical machinery. (3) The female doctor is shown from the waist up in a different clinical room, holding a white BBL laser device. She uses her left hand to gesture and emphasize her words while explaining. A medical monitor displaying various settings and graphs is visible behind her. (4) Close-up of the BBL device being applied to the patient's cheek. The device emits bright, rhythmic red flashes upon contact with the skin. The treated area shows slight redness. Text captions and hashtags are overlaid on the lower portion of the frame. (5) Focus on a medical device's touch screen interface showing numerical values like "1927nm". The doctor's finger points to specific settings on the display to explain the procedure. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional medical environment. (6) A static end-card graphic appears. It features a textured white background with the clinic's logo, contact phone numbers, and social media icons in black and grey. A slogan inviting viewers to contact the clinic is displayed at the bottom.
